title: Family Office CEO: One Day You’ll Have to Explain Why You Skipped Bitcoin
description:
Rony Vogel says wealth managers who skip Bitcoin will have to explain why, as 89% of family offices hold no crypto.
The post Family Office CEO: One Day You’ll Have to Explain Why You Skipped Bitcoin appeared first on BeInCrypto.
fullContent:
Most family offices still treat Bitcoin as something to watch, not something to own. Rony Vogel, CEO of Vogel Family Office, thinks that position is becoming harder to defend.

“If you’re not allocating to Bitcoin, there will be a day where you have to explain to your clients and your other family members why you have not allocated to it,” Vogel told BeInCrypto in a recent podcast interview. “So study Bitcoin to build up a conviction, whether it’s pro or against it. But not to study is very risky.”

His own family office sits at the other extreme: most of the family’s wealth is now in Bitcoin.

Interest Is High, Allocations Are Not

That makes Vogel a rare case. J.P. Morgan Private Bank’s 2026 Global Family Office Report, which surveyed 333 single-family offices in 30 countries, found that “traditional and emerging hedges remain limited: 72% report no gold exposure, and 89% report no exposure to cryptocurrencies.”

Interest is far higher. BNY Wealth’s 2025 survey found that 74% of family office professionals have either invested in crypto or are exploring it.

The two figures measure different things: one counts intent, the other actual holdings. Renesis, a crypto fund operations platform, argues that for family offices the real test is “whether the operation behind the returns looks like something a family would be comfortable explaining to the next generation.”

Conviction Built Over a Decade

Rony Vogel, who co-founded compliance software firm EQS Group, came to Bitcoin slowly. His family lost its wealth several times over the past century, to war, hyperinflation and expropriation. That history first pushed him into gold. The 2008 financial crisis reinforced it.

“Money can be printed endlessly to bail out everybody,” he said. “That led into gold, and that led eventually into Bitcoin.”

He first bought Bitcoin in 2013, but the conviction came in 2017. From then until 2023, he converted the proceeds of every business exit into Bitcoin.

“It’s the only asset which you can really own forever and pass on to other families endlessly,” he said.

Concentration Versus Conviction

Holding most of a family’s wealth in a single asset breaks the first rule of wealth management. Vogel answers with a comparison from the world of founders.

“If you had asked Jeff Bezos from Amazon, ‘don’t put all your eggs in one basket,’ he would say, ‘listen, I have the fastest horse in the race where I’m investing in,’ which is his own stock,” Vogel said. “The same counts for every other entrepreneur, and I see myself as a Bitcoin entrepreneur.”

Volatility and Trust

Convincing the rest of the family took years, mainly because of Bitcoin’s price swings.

“That trust wasn’t created overnight. It took many years,” Vogel said. “When we go from 126 down to 58, of course you get a lot of calls, not only from family members, also from friends.”

Bitcoin peaked near $126,000 in October 2025 and lost roughly half its value by early 2026. Vogel’s children, meanwhile, buy Bitcoin gradually in small amounts through dollar-cost averaging.

“When Bitcoin is down, you’re happy because you can accumulate more. If it’s up, you’re also happy,” he said. “One bitcoin is one bitcoin.”

Due Diligence, Not a Sales Pitch

Vogel doesn’t tell every family office to copy his allocation. His argument is about due diligence. Managers who study Bitcoin and decide against it have a defensible position. Those who never look at it are the ones taking the real risk.

title: Hashi Mainnet is Live With 20-Plus Partners, Bringing Bitcoin Finance to Sui at Scale
description: Hashi Mainnet is Live With 20-Plus Partners, Bringing Bitcoin Finance to Sui at Scale
fullContent:
Grand Cayman, Cayman Islands, November 19th, 2026, Chainwire

Anchorage Digital, Fluid, HoneyB, and Upshift support institutional and retail access to Bitcoin on Sui with BitGo, Inc. expected to follow in 2027

Hashi, Sui's native Bitcoin finance infrastructure, is now live on mainnet, with more than 20 custody, retail, and DeFi participants.

Bitcoin has spent years becoming one of the world's largest pools of capital. Now the infrastructure to put it to work has arrived, forming one of the broadest coalitions in Bitcoin finance. 

That coalition is still growing fast. The latest to join Hashi are Merkl, an onchain incentive platform; and Current, a lending protocol. These additions expand the ecosystem of DeFi products and services being built around Bitcoin on Sui.

Bitcoin-Native Finance, Now Live

Hashi keeps Bitcoin on the Bitcoin network and mints hBTC, a 1:1 Bitcoin-backed asset, on Sui. That hBTC can then serve as collateral for lending, borrowing, and other onchain financial products. 

Hashi is decentralized by design. It's secured by validators, not a single entity, using industry-leading cryptography. On top of that foundation, it connects leading providers across custody, trading, and decentralized finance to build financial products, giving Bitcoin holders many ways to put their assets to work.

Accessing Bitcoin Finance on Sui

With hBTC now live, Bitcoin holders have a new set of opportunities at their fingertips. That starts with borrowing against BTC and accessing new financial strategies through lending markets and vaults. 

To meet the specific needs of institutions, several new providers are offering new lending and vault facilities. 

Fluid’s institutional-grade lending protocol is now live on Sui, beginning with Bitcoin-backed stablecoin loans. Bitcoin holders can use Hashi to bring BTC onto Sui as hBTC, then use it as collateral on Fluid to borrow stablecoins, starting with USDC with more flows coming. 

“Bitcoin is the largest pool of idle capital in crypto,” said Samyak Jain, founder and CEO at Fluid. “With Hashi, it can now power deep, capital-efficient credit markets on Fluid.”

Institutional Access, Retail Opportunities, and Liquidity

For institutions, that infrastructure shows up as a custody problem solved. Institutions will be able to use both leading crypto custodians, Anchorage Digital and BitGo, Inc. (“BitGo”) to access Hashi. This model gives institutions a path to hold or deploy BTC into Hashi. Previously announced institutional partners, such as Cumberland and Wave Digital Assets will all play roles as early participants in deploying BTC and stablecoins on Hashi, providing liquidity to a variety of strategies on Sui. Sui DeFi protocols, including Blueprint Finance (Concrete), Bluefin, Cetus, Current, and Suilend will also unlock new lending opportunities, stablecoin credit, and yield strategies backed by Bitcoin. 

“Some of the world's largest Bitcoin holders are sitting on enormous amounts of untapped financial potential,” said Nathan McCauley, CEO and Co-Founder at Anchorage Digital. “Hashi gives our institutional clients a new way to access Bitcoin finance on Sui, with their BTC held in custody at Anchorage Digital Bank.”

If you’re an institution interested in deploying BTC or stablecoins on Hashi, please reach out to your custodian or hashi@sui.io. Users can explore more at sui.io/hashi. 

About Sui

Sui, where money moves as freely as messages, is a next-generation Layer 1 blockchain built for agentic finance and scalable global payments. Founded by the core team behind Meta’s stablecoin initiative and powered by an object-centric model, Sui makes assets, permissions, and user data programmable and ownable. Sui’s primitives offer builders everything they need to create high-performance payments and financial applications, including instant agentic payments. Learn more at sui.io. 

ContactSui Foundationmedia@sui.io

title: Bitcoin Price Rebounds Near $64,000 as Anthropic IPO Lifts Tech Stocks
description:
Bitcoin Magazine

Bitcoin Price Rebounds Near $64,000 as Anthropic IPO Lifts Tech Stocks
The bitcoin price climbed back to near $63,700 on Thursday morning as Anthropic's record IPO lifted tech stocks, though ETF outflows and Fed hike risk kept gains in check.
This post Bitcoin Price Rebounds Near $64,000 as Anthropic IPO Lifts Tech Stocks first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.
fullContent:
Bitcoin Magazine

Bitcoin Price Rebounds Near $64,000 as Anthropic IPO Lifts Tech Stocks

The bitcoin price climbed back to near $63,700 on Thursday morning, according to Bitcoin Magazine Pro data, as Anthropic’s record initial public offering lifted tech stocks and stock futures ahead of the U.S. open.

Bitcoin dipped near $62,000 late Wednesday after Federal Reserve minutes pointed to more rate hikes. It recovered overnight and briefly touched about $64,000 around 6 a.m. ET before easing slightly. The bitcoin price remains down roughly 11% from a week ago, when it traded above $71,000, and more than 20% below the roughly $82,200 level of a month ago.

Anthropic IPO lifts risk appetite

Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 per share on Wednesday, above its $70 to $78 range. The company sold about 980 million shares and raised $81.3 billion, topping SpaceX’s record offering in June, CNBC reported. The stock is set to begin trading on the Nasdaq on Thursday under the ticker ANT, with a fully diluted value of about $1.5 trillion.

The pricing sent Nasdaq-100 futures up 2% early Thursday, while S&P 500 futures added 1.1% and Dow futures rose about 299 points. Chipmakers led the move, with Nvidia (NVDA) up 1.5% and Micron Technology (MU) up almost 5% in premarket trading.

Some analysts had argued that investors were selling bitcoin to raise cash for the deal. Others questioned how much that selling actually weighed on the bitcoin price. With pricing now done, the bounce in crypto has tracked the broader rebound in tech. Gray market trading pointed to Anthropic shares opening as much as 24% above the IPO price.

Crypto stocks rebound before the open

Strategy (MSTR) traded near $93.90 before the bell, up about 4% after closing Wednesday at $90.32, down 6.4%. The company’s shares have fallen sharply alongside the bitcoin price this month, and a New York state pension fund boosted its Strategy stake by more than 10% in the third quarter, a 13F filing showed.

Coinbase (COIN) rose about 3% in premarket trading to near $114 after a nearly 4% drop on Wednesday. Bitcoin miners also moved higher. Riot Platforms (RIOT) gained about 6%, extending Wednesday’s 7% rally, while MARA Holdings (MARA) and IREN (IREN) each climbed about 4% to 5%.

ETF outflows and Fed risk weigh on the bitcoin price

Demand from U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs remains weak. The funds shed a net $306.5 million on Wednesday, led by $148.7 million out of BlackRock’s iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT) and $69.3 million from Fidelity’s FBTC. The ETFs have posted net outflows on 10 of the last 12 trading days.

The Fed is still the main headwind. Minutes from the October meeting showed that almost all officials judged further rate hikes “would likely be appropriate,” and a couple noted that a larger increase might be needed in December. Policymakers held rates at 3.75% to 4% in October, and Fed Governor Christopher Waller floated a half-point December hike on Wednesday.

Leverage has also been flushed out. About $181 million in bitcoin futures positions were liquidated over the past 24 hours, and roughly 77% of them were longs betting on higher prices. Options traders stayed defensive, with puts accounting for about 70% of bitcoin options volume.

Not every analyst is bearish, though. K33 Research said this week that bitcoin is in “deep value territory” and that “any entry below $70K is a gift from the market” for medium- to long-term investors. The firm noted that bitcoin had fallen below its 200-week moving average near $68,000.

At the time of writing, the bitcoin price is near $63,900.

This post Bitcoin Price Rebounds Near $64,000 as Anthropic IPO Lifts Tech Stocks first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

title: Hong Kong Regulator Flags Hyperliquid DEX as Suspicious, but HYPE Shrugs Off The Warning
description:

For Hyperliquid, HYPE, one of the largest decentralized exchanges for futures trading,..
The post Hong Kong Regulator Flags Hyperliquid DEX as Suspicious, but HYPE Shrugs Off The Warning appeared first on 99Bitcoins.
fullContent:
Hong Kong’s Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) added Hyperliquid to its public alert list of suspicious virtual asset trading platforms on Wednesday, November 18. The listing, under the name “Hyperliquid / Hyperliquid Hong Kong,” marks the decentralized exchange as unlicensed in the city. For Hyperliquid, HYPE, one of the largest decentralized exchanges for futures trading, it is a rare public warning from a major financial regulator. It also lands while HYPE is already 30% below its September high.

Just In: Hong Kong SFC Adds Hyperliquid to Suspicious Virtual Asset Trading Platforms Alert List

According to the official website of Hong Kong’s Securities and Futures Commission (SFC), the regulator added decentralized trading platform Hyperliquid and Hyperliquid Hong Kong to… pic.twitter.com/8zakYv6KYI

— Wu Blockchain (@WuBlockchain) November 19, 2026

HYPE, Hyperliquid’s token, dipped about 4% after the listing but was back above its pre-listing price by Thursday, trading near $69. We compared its hourly moves with Bitcoin’s and checked whether money left the exchange. Both point the same way: so far, traders have treated this Hyperliquid news as noise.

So is the SFC alert a real threat to Hyperliquid, or just paperwork?

A Warning Without a Ban For Hyperliquid HYPE, At Least for Now

The SFC keeps an alert list of firms it says are not licensed in Hong Kong but are suspected of serving or marketing to people there. It is a warning to investors, not a ban or a lawsuit. The regulator says users of unlicensed platforms have no protection under its rules and could struggle to get money back if something goes wrong.

Hyperliquid works differently from most names on the list. It is a decentralized exchange: trades settle on its own blockchain, and users connect a crypto wallet instead of opening an account. That makes it harder for a regulator to shut down, but it also means Hong Kong users get none of the protections a licensed exchange must offer.

So far, the alert hasn’t come with more:

  • No block or suspension: no website block or trading suspension has been announced.
  • No reply yet: Hyperliquid had not publicly responded as of Thursday.

DISCOVER: Hyperliquid Jumps After Trump Regulatory Comments

To separate the Hong Kong effect from the wider market, we lined up hourly prices for HYPE and Bitcoin on Hyperliquid, starting at 12:00 UTC on November 18.

  • The dip: HYPE’s lowest hourly close was 4.0% below the starting point, late on Wednesday. Bitcoin was down 2.9% in the same hour.
  • The recovery: by midday Thursday, HYPE was 0.7% above where it started, while Bitcoin was still 0.3% lower.
  • Exchange deposits: the Hyperliquid bridge, where users park dollars to trade, held $5.70 billion on Thursday, up slightly from $5.68 billion on November 17. Deposits had fallen 8% in the week before the listing, but they stopped falling after it.

HYPE did drop a bit harder than Bitcoin, but most of the move matched the wider market. If Hong Kong traders were rushing for the exits, deposits would show it. They don’t, at least not yet.

DISCOVER: Next 1000X Crypto – Here’s 10+ Crypto Tokens That Can Hit 1000x This Year

A Busy List: 14 Trading Platforms Flagged This Year

We counted every entry the SFC has filed under suspicious trading platforms. Hyperliquid is the 14th this year and the 69th since 2021.

  • By year: 1 in 2021, 3 in 2022, 7 in 2023, 32 in 2024, 12 in 2025 and 14 so far in 2026.
  • Familiar names: MEXC was added in February 2024 and BTCC in October 2026.
  • The warning case: JPEX was flagged in July 2022. It collapsed the following year in one of Hong Kong’s largest crypto fraud cases.

Many of the other entries are little-known sites, including look-alikes of the licensed exchange HashKey. Hyperliquid stands out as one of the largest platforms on the list, with $6.3 billion of futures traded on it in the past 24 hours.

For HYPE, the bigger risk is what comes next. Other regulators could follow Hong Kong, and big exchanges that list HYPE may face questions from their own regulators. For now, this Hyperliquid news carries no sign of an immediate crackdown.

HYPE Price Analysis: Holding Near the 200-Day Average

On the daily chart, HYPE trades at $68.99. It is close to its 200-day exponential moving average (EMA), an average that gives recent prices more weight, at $69.44, and below its 50-day EMA at $77.64. The 14-day relative strength index (RSI), a 0-100 gauge of momentum, reads 39.6, below the neutral 50.

HYPE is still up 171% this year, from $25.45 on January 1, while Bitcoin is down 28%. But it has fallen about 30% from its September 23 high of $98.

  • Support: $58.3, where HYPE turned in June, July and August. Last Friday’s low of $59.70 came close to it.
  • Resistance: $75.5, a level that held as support in September and October and capped HYPE in June. Above that, $89, where HYPE turned in September and October.
Path What has to happen Next stop
Bullish A daily close above $75.5 $89, the September-October turning point
Sideways Price holds between $58.3 and $75.5 A range around the 200-day EMA
Bearish A daily close below $58.3 $51.5, the June and August lows

For Hyperliquid HYPE, the thing to watch is whether other regulators follow Hong Kong. If none do and bridge deposits keep holding above $5.6 billion, the SFC alert will likely fade from view. A second warning from a major market, or a drop in deposits, would be a clearer sign that traders are worried.

title: Ledger Now X-Rays Suspect Hardware Wallets at Its French Factory
description:
Ledger X-ray checks are now available as the wallet maker verifies tampered devices in Berlin, probes Dubai, and finds a Nano Gen5 case.
The post Ledger Now X-Rays Suspect Hardware Wallets at Its French Factory appeared first on BeInCrypto.
fullContent:
Ledger X-ray inspections are now open to worried owners, as the hardware wallet maker verifies tampered devices in Berlin and probes two more in Dubai. The implants capture recovery phrases during setup.

Ledger insists its secure chip and operating system remain sound. However, the incident has now spread beyond Southeast Asia, leaving third-party buyers in three regions unsure about their savings.

What a Ledger X-ray Can Reveal That a Scale Cannot

For a limited time, Ledger Support can arrange a physical inspection of suspect units, including X-ray analysis. Owners ship the device to the company’s factory in Vierzon, France, and get it back afterward.

That offer targets a gap home checks cannot close. Some users had turned to weighing a hardware wallet, yet a matching scale reading proves little. A Ledger X-ray, by contrast, can show the hardware inside the case.

Ledger has also acknowledged that its Genuine Check, a built-in authenticity test, cannot spot an implant while the original security chip stays intact.

Meanwhile, the Ledger Donjon, the company’s in-house security lab, is examining suspected devices.

Ledger only requests devices through official Support tickets, the team says.

Why Berlin and Dubai Widen a Case That Began in Asia

In Germany, the tampered units trace back to Berlin. As a precaution, Ledger asks anyone who bought a device there since January 2026 to contact support.

Weeks ago, Ledger had said spot checks in Europe, including Germany, found no tampered stock.

Notably, users had flagged tampered devices in Europe weeks earlier, after Ledger first tied the losses to a single reseller.

Dubai is the newest front. There, the company is checking reports of two tampered units and how they entered circulation.

In Southeast Asia, where the spy chip case began, Ledger found one affected Ledger Nano Gen5. Resellers in the region remain paused.

On-chain analytics firm Bitquery has put total losses from drained Ledger devices near $102 million, most of it in USDT on TRON.

Ledger tells owners who suspect tampering to stop using the device. Funds should move to a new wallet set up on hardware from ledger.com, with a fresh recovery phrase.

Ledger expects more affected devices to surface, both through its probe and on social media. Rivals are adjusting too, with Trezor cutting off resellers to protect its supply chain.

For now, buying from third-party sellers carries a risk that a sealed box cannot rule out. In Berlin and Dubai, a Ledger X-ray may be the only way owners get a clear answer.

The post Ledger Now X-Rays Suspect Hardware Wallets at Its French Factory appeared first on BeInCrypto.

title: BTC - OBLIGACJE - METALE = ANTROPIC pociągnął kase? USD~PLN DXY GTA6 ECONOMISTS 20272
Bitcoin’s Next Major Move Tied to GTA VI? Traders Spot a Bizarre Pattern
description: "The Matrix is real. Not buying the game. Buying the dip," Merlijn The Trader said.
fullContent:
Everyone seems to be talking about GTA VI right now. After all, people have waited more than a decade for the new Grand Theft Auto, which is expected to be one of the most realistic games ever made. The anticipation has reached meme status online, with some joking that seemingly impossible things happened before Rockstar finally released the latest version.

And with GTA VI finally hitting the shelves, some market observers wonder whether the launch could coincide with a major turning point for Bitcoin. Here’s why.

The Interesting Parallel

X user Merlijn The Trader rewound the calendar to September 2013, when GTA V saw the light of day. The analyst noted that two weeks after the game’s release, BTC fell sharply toward $110, then rallied toward $1,150.

That said, he wondered whether history could repeat itself following the launch of the highly anticipated GTA VI, which is scheduled to go live later today (November 19).

“The Matrix is real. Not buying the game. Buying the dip,” he stated.

It is important to note that BTC’s drop in 2013 coincided with the FBI’s shutdown of the Silk Road darknet marketplace, a development that was likely a far more significant catalyst for the price crash.

Meanwhile, speculation has been growing that GTA VI could feature some form of crypto integration. Whether that turns out to be true remains to be seen, and it is even less clear if Bitcoin would be among the supported digital assets.

Some of the Latest Predictions

According to CF, BTC may spend the next one to two months trading sideways, thus “driving the timeline crazy.” The analyst believes this consolidation could end in December 2026 or January 2027 when the asset could begin climbing towards $100,000.

As of this writing, BTC trades near $64,000, down 13% for the week. Some think a potential reason for the decline is the upcoming IPO of AI giant Anthropic, whose shares are expected to begin trading later today and which may be draining capital from the crypto market. However, a similar pattern was observed earlier this year ahead of SpaceX’s IPO, when BTC headed south in the weeks leading up to the listing and posted a substantial rebound once the IPO hype faded.

The actions of one whale, though, suggest the price may dump even more in the short term. Max Crypto revealed that a mysterious market participant recently opened a $90 million short position on BTC with 13x leverage, saying the investor has made over $10 million in profits in the past week.

Beyond the size of the bet itself, the move may trigger panic and prompt other traders to adopt a more cautious stance, causing another wave of panic selling.

title: Analyst Aman Sees ARB Buying Zone at $0.13 and a $0.25 Target if Momentum Returns
description: Arbitrum opens a second builder cohort with Robinhood Chain as ARB trades near $0.13. Analyst Aman sees a buying zone, but support near $0.128 is the key test.
fullContent:
Quick Take

  • Arbitrum opened a second mentorship cohort with Robinhood Chain, ending in a demo day with cash prizes.
  • ARB trades below both its 50-day and 200-day averages, and momentum gauges still favor sellers.
  • Analyst Aman calls the current area a buying zone. His recovery case depends on a narrow band just above the price.

Arbitrum is recruiting a new wave of builders. The project opened applications for its second mentorship cohort after a first round that helped ten teams raise funding.

The token has not shared in that progress. ARB has lost about a third of its value in a month, and one analyst now sees a buying opportunity. Traders want to know whether sellers are finally running out of supply or simply pausing.

Arbitrum Opens a Second Builder Cohort With Robinhood Chain

The Mentorship Program is run together with Robinhood Chain and backs teams building on Arbitrum One and that network. Mentors help with product strategy, go-to-market plans, liquidity, tokenomics and fundraising.

The cohort ends with a demo day carrying $100,000 in combined prizes. Applications close December 6.

Its first round drew 902 applications, and ten teams made it to Demo Day. Those teams went on to raise more than $1 million combined, according to the project.

More builders on the network does not automatically mean more demand for ARB, though. The token gains only if that activity turns into buying.

Crypto analyst Aman sees the current price area as his first buying zone. He set $0.25 as a recovery target, but only if ARB starts a rally of higher highs. That condition puts the focus on the chart.

ARB Trades Beneath Both Long Averages After a Month of Losses

Arbitrum (ARB) daily price with the nearest support (green) and resistance (red). Source: TradingView

ARB trades near $0.13, and the daily chart shows a token stuck in a downtrend. Over the past month, the price fell about 35%. The past week alone took off roughly 16%. Most of that slide came recently, so sellers have been pressing harder.

Two moving averages frame the picture. A moving average smooths out daily swings by tracking the average closing price over a set number of days. The 50-day average sits near $0.16 and reflects the past couple of months. The 200-day average, near $0.15, tracks the longer trend.

ARB trades below both lines. That means recent buyers and longer-term holders are, on average, sitting on losses. Both averages now act as ceilings. Rallies toward them often meet sellers looking to exit near breakeven.

The order of the averages also matters. The shorter 50-day line still sits above the 200-day line, but the price has fallen through both. That pattern often shows a trend that has rolled over and has not yet found a floor.

ARB finished the latest session flat, with no fresh losses after a week of steady declines. A quiet day like this can mean sellers are running low on supply for now.

One flat session does not change the direction. Buyers have not pushed the price higher, and the token remains near the bottom of its recent range.

Sellers Still Hold the Momentum Gauges

The Relative Strength Index, or RSI, is a 0 to 100 gauge of momentum. It reads about 34 on ARB's daily chart. That level counts as weak, but it sits above 30, the line that usually marks a sold-out market.

In practice, sellers still have room to push. Oversold readings often come before relief bounces, and ARB has not reached that zone yet.

Other gauges point the same way. The MACD, a tool that compares short and longer price trends, remains below its signal line. That means downside momentum has not faded. Trend-strength readings also show a trend taking shape, with sellers leading it.

Together, these signals describe a market that has slowed without turning. Aman's recovery call needs that turn, and it has not come yet.

Where a Bounce Must Start and Where a Slide Could End

Near-term levels sit close together. Support rests near $0.128, just under the current price. A sustained move above $0.135 could improve short-term momentum. That narrow band is where buyers would need to show up first.

If that floor gives way, the chart points lower. The nearest major support sits near $0.11. A break there would expose the next level, around $0.083. That drop would push ARB well below Aman's buying zone and weaken his setup.

On the upside, the first resistance lines up with the 200-day average. Reclaiming that level would put the price back on its long-term trend line.

The bigger test comes near $0.17. Clearing that resistance would mean ARB has started printing the higher highs Aman wants. Until then, his target remains a distant marker.

Two Paths for ARB Over the Next Three Days

ARB's direction hinges on the narrow band around its current price.

  • Bullish: A sustained move above the near-term trigger level would open a path toward first resistance at the 200-day average. A daily close back below the nearby floor would cancel this setup.
  • Bearish: A break of that nearby floor would expose the major support level identified on the daily chart. A reclaim of the near-term trigger would cancel the bearish case and hand buyers the initiative.

Builder Momentum Has Not Reached the Token Yet

The mentorship pipeline gives Arbitrum more builders, but ARB holders have not felt it yet. Aman's buying zone is a bet on a momentum turn that the gauges have not confirmed.

If the nearby floor fails, ARB could slide well beneath the analyst's entry before any recovery begins.

title: Rene Haas to Take Over Nvidia? What Will Happen to Crypto?
description:
Rene Haas could take over Nvidia after leading Arm's AI expansion. Here's what his appointment could mean for Bitcoin and crypto markets.
The post Rene Haas to Take Over Nvidia? What Will Happen to Crypto? appeared first on Cryptonews.
fullContent:
Nvidia could be about to hand its biggest job to the man who helped turn Arm into one of the world’s most valuable chip companies. Rene Haas is now being considered as a potential successor to Jensen Huang at Nvidia, a familiar face at the center of the AI industry’s biggest leadership change.

Bloomberg reported that Nvidia’s recruitment firm had approached Haas as part of its search for a new chief executive. Haas previously spent seven years at Nvidia before joining Arm in 2013. He became Arm’s CEO in 2022 and has since overseen its expansion into the booming AI infrastructure market.

The appointment would put someone with experience at both companies in charge of Nvidia’s next chapter. But what is it for crypto? Could Haas push the AI boom even further, and what would that mean for Bitcoin and the rest of the market?

Rene Haas Turned Arm Into an AI Infrastructure Player, But Could He Do the Same at Nvidia?

Haas is not an outsider to Nvidia. He previously ran the company’s computing products business between 2006 and 2013, giving him direct experience with the company before its transformation into an AI powerhouse.

His subsequent run at Arm offers a glimpse of what he might bring to the role. Arm reported $4.92 billion in revenue for its fiscal 2026, up from $4.01 billion the previous year. Its profit before tax climbed from $756 million to $960 million. The company has also moved beyond its traditional chip-design licensing business, introducing its own AGI CPU for AI data centers in March 2026.

Arm’s technology already reaches more than 99% of smartphones sold worldwide. Its designs also power computing infrastructure used by major cloud providers and Nvidia itself.

Haas helped position the company for a much larger role in the AI economy. Now, his next challenge could be taking Nvidia beyond selling the chips powering that expansion.

Nvidia’s existing business gives him an enormous starting point. The company generated $115.8 billion in quarterly revenue in its latest results, with data center sales accounting for $107.6 billion. Revenue increased 103% from a year earlier.

Its next-generation Vera Rubin platform has also entered production and begun shipping. A new CEO would inherit an extraordinary growth engine, but also the responsibility of deciding how aggressively Nvidia should expand its influence across the AI industry.

If Haas brings his Arm strategy to Nvidia, we could see a push into integrated computing platforms, data center infrastructure and new AI applications. That could create another wave of investment across the technology sector.

Discover: The Best Token Presales

Haas and Crypto: What Will Happen?

Crypto could benefit if Haas turns Nvidia’s next chapter into another catalyst for AI infrastructure spending. The connection extends beyond tokens carrying artificial intelligence branding. Bitcoin and Ethereum have increasingly moved in tandem with technology stocks during periods when investors shift between risk assets.

A stronger Nvidia could help restore confidence in the AI investment cycle, especially if investors believe its leadership transition will not interrupt infrastructure spending.

Decentralized computing projects such as Render, Bittensor, Artificial Superintelligence Alliance, and Akash could also benefit. These networks are trying to capture demand for GPU resources, distributed computing, and AI development.

More spending on AI infrastructure would create opportunities for decentralized alternatives. Developers need computing power, and centralized providers cannot always meet every requirement at the right price.

The bigger opportunity could come from investor appetite rather than immediate demand for crypto tokens. If Nvidia shares regain momentum under Rene Haas, technology investors could become more comfortable taking risks elsewhere. That would give crypto a potential source of buying interest.

Haas has already demonstrated what he can do with Arm. Taking over Nvidia would give him a considerably larger platform, with consequences extending well beyond semiconductor stocks.

title: Jacobs Scores Key Role in Sanofi's New Insulin Factory in Germany
description:
Jacobs Solutions Inc. (NYSE:J) on Thursday announced that Sanofi (NASDAQ:SNY) selected the company to provide engineering, procurement, and construction management services for a new insulin manufacturing facility in Frankfurt, Germany.
Jacobs Secures Sanofi Manufacturing Contract
The facility, located alongside Sanofi’s existing insulin manufacturing campus, will support production of multiple insulin products and strengthen supply reliability.
Jacobs will oversee design, procurement, construction management and commissioning, using existing site infrastructure and advanced manufacturing technologies.
Earlier this year, Engineering News-Record ranked Jacobs the No. 1 Pharmaceuticals Design Firm. The company also provides EPCM services for FUJIFILM Biotechnologies’ $3.2 billion Holly Springs campus.
Jacobs Announces Recent Airport and Rail Contracts
On Nov. 17, Jacobs announced a five-year contract with the Metropolitan Washington Airports Authority to support modernization projects at Washington Dulles International Airport and Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport.
The agreement covers engineering oversight, project controls and construction management, with options for extensions.
On Nov. 13, Jacobs and AECOM announced their appointment to Irish Rail’s multidisciplinary consultancy framework.
Their joint venture also secured the framework’s first project, the Limerick–Limerick Junction rail upgrade, covering engineering, design, environmental assessment and project delivery services.
Earnings Preview and Analyst Outlook
Jacobs Solutions is scheduled to report earnings on Nov. 23, 2026. 
Analysts expect earnings per share of $2.13, compared with $1.75 a year earlier, while revenue is projected at $2.56 billion, down from $3.15 billion. 
Jacobs carries a consensus Buy rating, with an average analyst price forecast of $171.
Citigroup maintained its Buy rating and raised its price forecast to $188 on Oct. 23. KeyBanc lowered its forecast to $166 while maintaining an Overweight rating on Oct. 15, while Truist Securities cut its forecast to $160 and maintained a Hold rating on Oct. 5.
Technical Analysis
Jacobs Solutions maintains a bullish technical setup, trading above its key moving averages. The 20-day SMA remains above the 50-day SMA, while an August golden cross—when the 50-day SMA crossed above the 200-day SMA—reinforces the upward trend.
The Relative Strength Index (RSI) stands at 59.32, indicating neutral-to-bullish momentum without overbought conditions. The MACD also remains above its signal line, supporting the positive trend.
With no clearly defined support or resistance levels, traders may watch previous swing highs and lows for potential breakouts or reversals.
Jacobs shares have gained 8.40% over the past 12 months, reflecting positive longer-term price performance.
Benzinga Edge Rankings
Jacobs Solutions’ Benzinga Edge scores highlight strong Momentum at 88.26, contrasting with weaker Quality (22.33), Value (19.50) and Growth (8.82) scores.
The rankings indicate strong stock price momentum despite weaker fundamental metrics, putting earnings and guidance in focus ahead of the company’s upcoming results.

title: Anthropic IPO: Expert Opinions and Concerns
description:
Anthropic PBC’s (NASDAQ:ANT) initial public offering has drawn strong investor interest as the AI company prepares to enter the public markets at a valuation that has intensified debate over its growth potential, capital needs and long-term economics.
Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 per share, above the $70-to-$78 range marketed to investors, according to reports.
Bloomberg reported that the higher price is expected to raise at least $68 billion.
Strong Demand Signals AI Appetite
Harbor Capital Advisors portfolio manager Justin Menne told Bloomberg on Wednesday that Anthropic’s pricing above the initial range shows "a resounding statement around the appetite for risk" and investor demand for more AI exposure.
Menne urged investors to take a long-term view rather than focus on first-day volatility. He said buyers should evaluate Anthropic over three, five or 10 years as the broader AI trend develops.
Altimeter Capital CEO Brad Gerstner told CNBC on Monday that his firm planned to submit a $5 billion order, more than five times its largest previous IPO order.
He called Anthropic a "cornerstone compounder for a long period of time" and said he expects Anthropic and OpenAI to capture a large share of AI’s economic value.
Laffer Tengler Investments’ Nancy Tengler also highlighted demand, saying the offering was oversubscribed by roughly six times. She told CNBC on Thursday that she would "much rather be an owner of Anthropic than OpenAI," citing Anthropic’s revenue growth, inferencing margins and focus.
Analysts See Large Growth Opportunity
New Street Research’s Pierre Ferragu initiated Anthropic with a Buy rating and a $105 price forecast. He compared Anthropic with early cloud leaders, arguing the company can address a $36 trillion knowledge-work market.
Ferragu told CNBC on Wednesday that a roughly $1.5 trillion valuation equals about 8.5 times next year’s sales, which he viewed as comparable to hyperscalers rather than higher-multiple software companies.
William Blair’s Arjun Bhatia also called a $1.5 trillion valuation attractive. Based on his 2027 estimates, he told CNBC on Tuesday that Anthropic would trade at roughly seven to eight times forward revenue while growing its top line about 150%.
Bhatia estimates Anthropic could eventually become a $1 trillion revenue business by 2035, though he said the company may need about $2.5 trillion in cumulative compute to reach that scale.
Baillie Gifford’s Peter Singlehurst told CNBC on Wednesday that Anthropic’s long-term success will depend less on its IPO-day valuation and more on whether it can keep developing frontier models, sustain high revenue growth and become profitable.
Cash Flow, Valuation And Competition Raise Risks
Former SEC Chair Gary Gensler focused on Anthropic’s roughly $895 billion in forward commitments and questioned whether future revenue can support them.
He told Bloomberg on Wednesday that Anthropic lacks the cash flow that semiconductor companies such as NVIDIA generate and called that a larger systemic risk around Anthropic and OpenAI.
Niles Investment Management founder Dan Niles told CNBC on Thursday that he worries about slowing combined growth at Anthropic and OpenAI and rising operating losses. He argued investors are becoming more selective and increasingly focused on cash flow.
Governance And Strategy Remain Key Questions
NYU professor Aswath Damodaran told CNBC on Tuesday that Anthropic offers investors a direct way to bet on AI’s long-term potential, but argued that a $1.5 trillion valuation already requires significant future growth.
He also criticized Anthropic’s governance structure, saying it could eventually warrant a valuation discount.

title: Denmark unanimously approves Greenland security deal with the U.S.
description:
By Stine Jacobsen and Tom Little 
   COPENHAGEN, Nov 19 (Reuters) - Denmark's parliament on Thursday unanimously ratified a security agreement with the United States on Greenland, hoping to end a standoff over the Arctic island's ‌future that has rattled transatlantic relations. 
   The US, Denmark and Greenland signed the agreement in September after US ‌President Donald Trump repeatedly threatened to take control of the mineral-rich self-governing Danish territory of 57,000 people. 
   The executive agreement takes effect once Denmark's foreign ​ministry tells the US in a diplomatic note that procedures are complete. It does not need approval from the US Senate. 
   It expands the US military's role in Greenland, including permission to establish a "Golden Dome" missile defence system, while reaffirming Danish sovereignty and Greenlanders' right to self-determination. 
   The signatories will now start work on a new Greenland law to screen outside investors on security ‌grounds and plans for two new US ⁠military bases, as outlined in the agreement, Denmark’s Defence Minister Jeppe Bruus told Reuters. 
   "I expect that the US will now also start to be more concrete on the purposes and ⁠the arrangement around these two areas," he said Bruus. 
   Trump's refusal to rule out military or economic force to acquire the island triggered a diplomatic crisis within NATO in January and months of intensive negotiations. 
   DIFFICULT TIME FOR GREENLANDERS 
   Naaja Nathanielsen, a Greenlandic member of the ​Danish ​parliament, said Trump's pressure had led to distrust in Greenland ​towards the US administration. 
   "It's been really difficult for ‌Greenlanders these past two years. It's been seeping into every aspect of our lives," Nathanielsen told Reuters. She hoped the agreement would open a path to dialogue after hurtful rhetoric within the Western alliance. 
   The US ambassador to Denmark, Kenneth Howery, welcomed the vote result, calling the agreement "a tremendous accomplishment" that bolsters the security of all sides, including NATO. 
   Greenland's parliament ratified the deal this month. Danish lawmakers expressed relief and hope that the deal will normalize the situation in ‌Greenland. 
   Mikkel Vedby Rasmussen, a political science professor at the University ​of Copenhagen said the deal was more likely a beginning than an ​end. 
   "With the treaty in hand, the US will ​be able to demand greater influence on decisions that have security policy implications and on ‌part of the extraction of strategic resources," he ​said. 
   Other experts say the new ​agreement does not add much US military access to Greenland. The northernmost US base is already in Greenland, which lies on the shortest route from Europe to North America. 
   Trump last month said that "massive oil, gas ​and mineral exploration" was set to ‌begin on Greenland, a contentious statement on a territory that has banned new drilling for crude. ​Denmark has said any resource extraction must respect local law. 
   (Reporting by Stine Jacobsen, editing by Jacob ​Gronholt-Pedersen, Louise Rasmussen, Rod Nickel, Thomas Derpinghaus and Chizu Nomiyama ) 
This article originally appeared on Reuters at https://uk.news.yahoo.com/denmark-expected-ratify-trump-deal-050311767.html

"It's been really difficult for ‌Greenlanders these past two years. It's been seeping into every aspect of our lives," Nathanielsen told Reuters. She hoped the agreement would open a path to dialogue after hurtful rhetoric within the Western alliance.

The US ambassador to Denmark, Kenneth Howery, welcomed the vote result, calling the agreement "a tremendous accomplishment" that bolsters the security of all sides, including NATO.

Greenland's parliament ratified the deal this month. Danish lawmakers expressed relief and hope that the deal will normalize the situation in ‌Greenland.

Mikkel Vedby Rasmussen, a political science professor at the University ​of Copenhagen said the deal was more likely a beginning than an ​end.

"With the treaty in hand, the US will ​be able to demand greater influence on decisions that have security policy implications and on ‌part of the extraction of strategic resources," he ​said.

Other experts say the new ​agreement does not add much US military access to Greenland. The northernmost US base is already in Greenland, which lies on the shortest route from Europe to North America.

Trump last month said that "massive oil, gas ​and mineral exploration" was set to ‌begin on Greenland, a contentious statement on a territory that has banned new drilling for crude. ​Denmark has said any resource extraction must respect local law.

title: Manchester United Stock Falls As Quarterly Losses Balloon
description:
Manchester United plc (NYSE:MANU) stock fell Thursday after the English soccer club reported weaker-than-expected first-quarter fiscal 2027 results. However, the company reaffirmed its full-year revenue and adjusted EBITDA outlook.
Manchester United reported an adjusted quarterly loss of 7.69 pence per share, wider than the analyst consensus estimate of 6 pence. The adjusted loss widened from 1.48 pence per share a year earlier.
The reported basic and diluted loss per share widened to 10.50 pence from 3.85 pence a year earlier.
In U.S. dollar terms, the adjusted loss was 10 cents per share, wider than the estimate of 8 cents.
Revenue rose 4.1% year over year to 146.1 million British pounds, falling short of the analyst consensus estimate of 151 million pounds. In U.S. dollar terms, revenue came to $196.43 million, missing the estimate of $199.95 million.
Champions League Lifts Broadcasting Revenue
Broadcasting revenue rose 17.7% to 35.2 million pounds, driven by the men’s first team’s participation in the UEFA Champions League. The team did not participate in European competitions during the same period last year.
However, one fewer Premier League match during the quarter partly offset the gains.
Matchday revenue increased 2.3% to 26.8 million pounds, while commercial revenue edged down 0.1% to 84.1 million pounds.
Sponsorship revenue fell 3% to 45.6 million pounds due to a shorter preseason tour resulting from the timing of the 2026 FIFA World Cup. However, a new training kit partnership with Betway largely offset the decline.
Meanwhile, retail, merchandising, apparel and product licensing revenue increased 3.5% to 38.5 million pounds.
Lower Player Sale Profits Weigh on Earnings
Manchester United posted an operating loss of 3 million pounds, compared with an operating profit of 13 million pounds a year earlier.
Profit from player disposals fell 54% to 20.7 million pounds from 45 million pounds.
However, the operating loss before profit from player disposals narrowed to 23.7 million pounds from 32 million pounds. Total operating expenses declined 1.5%.
Meanwhile, employee benefit expenses rose 8.6% to 79.9 million pounds, reflecting the club’s participation in the Champions League.
The quarterly net loss widened 174.2% to 18.1 million pounds from 6.6 million pounds. Adjusted net loss increased to 13.3 million pounds from 2.6 million pounds.
However, adjusted EBITDA increased 2.2% to 27.5 million pounds from 26.9 million pounds.
Cash Flow Improves
Net cash inflow from operating activities totaled 47.7 million pounds, compared with an outflow of 1.3 million pounds a year earlier.
Cash and cash equivalents declined to 55.5 million pounds from 80.5 million pounds a year earlier. The cash balance fell by 11.8 million pounds during the quarter.
Borrowings under the club’s revolving credit facility stood at 200 million pounds. Total current borrowings, including accrued interest, declined to 207.1 million pounds from 268 million pounds a year earlier.
Meanwhile, dollar-denominated noncurrent borrowings increased 19.2% to $775 million from $650 million following the refinancing of the club’s senior secured notes in June 2026.
Manchester United Reaffirms Full-Year Outlook
For fiscal 2027, Manchester United reaffirmed its revenue forecast of 740 million pounds to 760 million pounds.
The club also maintained its adjusted EBITDA forecast of 205 million pounds to 225 million pounds.
"Our revenue remains strong and on track, while we continue to grow sustainably," said CEO Omar Berrada.
Manchester United Announces Coaching Change
The club said Mauricio Pochettino has joined as head coach of the men’s first team following the departure of Michael Carrick earlier this month.
MANU Price Action: Manchester United shares were down 7.53% at $20.25 during premarket trading on Thursday, according to Benzinga Pro data.

title: Ripple CEO Garlinghouse Predicts Crypto Rebound After Anthropic IPO
description:
Ripple‘s CEO Brad Garlinghouse says the recent cryptocurrency sell-off reflects investors pulling liquidity from Bitcoin (CRYPTO: BTC) and XRP (CRYPTO: XRP) to participate in Anthropic’s highly anticipated IPO.
In an interview with CNBC Wednesday, Garlinghouse noted that investors are shifting capital into high-profile technology IPOs, creating temporary selling pressure across digital assets.
He compared the current downturn to the sell-off surrounding SpaceX’s IPO, which was followed by a cryptocurrency market rebound.
Garlinghouse also expressed confidence in Anthropic’s market debut, predicting it would be extremely well received despite broader concerns about AI valuations and geopolitical uncertainty.
BTC’s Rare Crash Signals Potential Recovery
Digital Asset News noted that Bitcoin’s decline ahead of Anthropic’s debut is roughly 18%, comparable to 18.8% drop surrounding SpaceX’s IPO.
A historical pattern for the current market cycle suggests Bitcoin could recover from its recent sell-off, although further downside remains possible.
The rough 12% weekly decline below its 200-week moving average resembles three previous market crashes:
August 2015: Bitcoin suffered another 14% decline before recovering.
March 2020: Bitcoin dropped an additional 17% before rallying 82% over the following three months.
June 2022: Bitcoin fell another 9.8% before gaining 6.3% over three months.
The analysis suggests that sharp declines below the long-term moving average have historically preceded recoveries, although their timing and magnitude varied considerably.

title: Regeneron Wins FDA Nod For Livsayis, 4x-Year GMG Shot
description:
On Wednesday, the U.S. Food and Drug Administration approved Regeneron Pharmaceuticals Inc.’s (NASDAQ:REGN) Livsayis (cemdisiran) for generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) in adults who test positive for anti-acetylcholine receptor (AChR) antibodies, the predominant form of the disease.
Livsayis stands as the first and only approved small interfering RNA (siRNA) therapy for gMG. It also represents the only FDA-approved gMG treatment that patients receive subcutaneously four times a year.
This novel therapeutic targets complement component factor 5 (C5) to reduce circulating C5 protein levels, limiting terminal complement activation, a key driver of the disease.
Livsayis Delivers Rapid Symptom Relief In Phase 3 Trial
The FDA based its approval on findings from the Phase 3 NIMBLE trial. At 24 weeks, Livsayis produced a 4.5-point least-squares mean improvement from baseline on the Myasthenia Gravis-Activities of Daily Living (MG-ADL) total score, versus 2.2 points for placebo, reflecting a 2.3-point placebo-adjusted gain.
Clinicians use the MG-ADL scale to evaluate patient-reported daily functions, including talking, chewing, swallowing, breathing, vision, and mobility.
In the trial, 76.6% of Livsayis patients achieved at least a 3-point MG-ADL improvement at week 24, outpacing the 44.1% placebo responder rate.
Patients also recorded strong gains on the Quantitative Myasthenia Gravis (QMG) muscle function scale, which assesses vision, speaking, swallowing, breathing, and limb mobility.
Livsayis generated a 4.2-point QMG improvement at 24 weeks versus 1.5 points for placebo, delivering a 2.8-point placebo-adjusted benefit. Additionally, 48.4% of Livsayis patients achieved at least a 5-point QMG improvement at week 24, versus 19.0% on placebo.
Livsayis delivered rapid relief, sparking a clinically meaningful 2.5-point MG-ADL improvement within two weeks that deepened over time.
Patients sustained this symptom relief and disease control through 24 weeks without signs of waning efficacy.
Global Regulatory Review And International Expansion
European Union regulators are reviewing a submission for Livsayis in gMG, and officials anticipate a decision in the second half of 2027.
Regeneron also plans regulatory submissions in additional markets, including Japan.
Livsayis was discovered by Alnylam Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (NASDAQ:ALNY) and advanced into Phase 2 development by Alnylam before becoming part of an RNAi collaboration with Regeneron.
In 2024, Regeneron assumed sole responsibility for development, manufacturing, and commercialization of the molecule.
Per the agreement with Regeneron, Alnylam will receive a $25 million payment for the approval and is eligible to receive tiered, double-digit royalties of up to 15% on global net sales.
REGN Price Action: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals shares were up 0.26% at $948.00 during premarket trading on Thursday, according to Benzinga Pro data.

title: Nike unveils plan that suggests its days of putting politics ahead of sports may be numbered | Matt Calkins
description: Nike CEO Elliott Hill unveiled the "Full Stride Ahead" turnaround plan at its first Investor Day in nine years, refocusing the sports brand on athletes.
fullContent:
I'm rooting for Nike.

The world is better when the most iconic sports brand in history is on top of its game.

This is the company that brought us "Bo Knows," "It's gotta be the shoes" and "Chicks dig the long ball."

It gave us Tiger Woods juggling a golf ball, Andre Agassi and Pete Sampras trading forehands in the middle of a New York City street and Charles Barkley going one-on-one with Godzilla.

These ads made you want to pick up a baseball bat or a 5-iron — not a picket sign. And there are encouraging signs that Nike wants to be that company again.

NIKE CEO MAY HAVE JUST ADMITTED THE COMPANY WENT TOO WOKE AS STOCK HITS 12-YEAR LOW

At Nike's first Investor Day in nine years Tuesday, CEO Elliott Hill unveiled a long-term turnaround strategy dubbed "Full Stride Ahead." With the Swoosh's stock having lost half its value over the past two years, Hill emphasized a return to the company's roots.

"Nike is at its best when we start with the athlete and bring the full power of the company together around sport," Hill said in a statement.

Yes. Sport. This is what made Nike a juggernaut in the first place.

There are myriad reasons for the company's dramatic decline — its stock price hit a 12-year low last month. It oversaturated the market with retro sneakers, damaged relationships with retailers by prioritizing direct-to-consumer sales and ceded ground to competitors such as Hoka and On. Its business in China has been reeling, too.

But it's impossible to ignore that, somewhere along the way, Nike seemed to prioritize activism every bit as much as athleticism.

As I wrote last month, this is the company that made Colin Kaepernick the face of its 30th anniversary "Just Do It" campaign. It released a "For Once, Don't Do It" commercial in 2020, telling Americans not to turn their backs on racism. And in 2023, it enlisted transgender influencer Dylan Mulvaney to promote women's leggings and sports bras.

FROM COLIN KAEPERNICK TO DYLAN MULVANEY, NIKE'S DECADE OF LEFT-WING ACTIVISM HAS FINALLY CAUGHT UP TO IT

It's hard not to wonder if the higher-ups were more focused on appeasing the employees inside the building than courting customers outside it. But it sounds like those days might be over.

In an Oct. 1 memo, Hill wrote that "over the past year, we've put sport at the center of everything we do." I wondered at the time if that was as much a confession as it was a mission statement.

Hill struck a similar tone Tuesday, outlining five priority sports — running, training, soccer, basketball and outdoor — while emphasizing a return to athlete-centered marketing.

"Start with the athlete and the problem that we are solving. Bring product and storytelling together around the athlete," Hill said during his presentation.

That second sentence is particularly encouraging. Few companies in the history of advertising have been better storytellers than Nike. And the beauty of those stories was that you didn't have to be a Republican or a Democrat to appreciate them. You just had to love sports.

NIKE FORGOT THAT REPUBLICANS BUY SNEAKERS, TOO, AND NOW IT'S GETTING BOOTED FROM THE S&P 100

THE CRAIG CARTON SHOW–UNFILTERED, UNAPOLOGETIC AND UNMISSABLE. DOWNLOAD HIS DAILY PODCAST NOW!

Plus, it wasn't just executives taking the stage Tuesday. Caitlin Clark, reigning NBA MVP Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and Olympic gold medalist Sha'Carri Richardson were among the athletes Nike showcased at its headquarters.

What's more, given how long it took Nike to get Clark's signature shoe to market, the company revealed that the Caitlin 1 was the largest women's signature shoe launch in its history.

Turns out there's quite a market for celebrating athletic excellence.

That's not to say Nike should abandon its pursuit of cultural relevance. But there is a difference between shaping culture and fighting a culture war. Nike was at its best when it was doing the former.

I miss that Nike. And for the first time in a while, I'm optimistic we're getting it back.

What are your thoughts on Nike's plan? Let us know at matthew.calkins@outkick.com

title: Homeowner says squatter hijacked his property in affluent community, stole deed in $1 scheme

A homeowner’s lucrative Airbnb investment within an affluent Pacific Northwest community was allegedly hijacked by the very property manager he hired, sparking a months-long squatter standoff that ended with a $1 deed, a shooting on the property, and the manager behind bars.

Ellis Cameron shared his story with Fox News Digital and says he hired Junior Patrick Adelbai to manage property he purchased and renovated in Edgewood, Washington. Instead of managing the rental, the homeowner said the alleged squatter decided to move his family in, causing a months-long legal battle for the homeowner and making him unable to sell it.

The homeowner intended to have Adelbai rent out the property for $6,500 a month. After the pair reached an agreement, Cameron changed the locks to prep it for renters.

Cameron said he was left paying the mortgage without the rental income he was anticipating to cover the payments.

He asked the family to leave on numerous occasions, enlisting the help of law enforcement at times, but was told the dispute was a "civil matter" that would have to be resolved through the court system.

'TOXIC COCKTAIL' OF RENTER PROTECTIONS DESTROYED $39M AFFORDABLE HOUSING INVESTMENT AS DEM CITIES FOLLOW SUIT

"You have squatter-friendly laws that protect the squatters," Cameron said. "In Washington state, especially Pierce County, it's a high-risk agreement to decide to rent your place out because if something doesn't go right, it's going to be problematic for you. In Washington state, you can't turn off the squatters' utilities, you can't threaten them."

title: Popular cruise ship rocked by illness outbreak as nearly 150 passengers and crew fall victim
description: With testing still pending, the CDC says nearly 150 people aboard Princess Cruises' Caribbean Princess reported vomiting and diarrhea on a 12-night voyage.
fullContent:
A Caribbean cruise has taken an uncomfortable turn for nearly 150 passengers and crew members who have fallen sick with stomach illness symptoms — with an infectious disease expert providing important insight into a very "common" issue. 

A total of 148 people aboard Princess Cruises' Caribbean Princess — 134 passengers and 14 crew members — have reported the symptoms, according to the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC).

The ship departed Nov. 11 and is not scheduled to return until Nov. 23. It is carrying 2,936 passengers and 1,132 crew members, the CDC said.

HIGHLY CONTAGIOUS NOROVIRUS SPREADS ON CRUISE SHIP, SICKENING OVER 100 PASSENGERS AND CREW

Its 12-night round-trip voyage from Fort Lauderdale, Florida, includes scheduled stops in Aruba, Colombia, the Panama Canal, Costa Rica and Grand Cayman, according to the ship's itinerary.

Princess Cruises reported the outbreak to the CDC's Vessel Sanitation Program (VSP) on Nov. 15. It also confirmed the situation in a statement to Fox News Digital.

"Princess Cruises can confirm that a limited number of guests aboard Caribbean Princess have reported mild gastrointestinal illness," the company said in its statement. 

"Our crew responded promptly by implementing enhanced sanitation protocols across the ship, including comprehensive cleaning and disinfection measures."

It concluded, "While most guests remain unaffected, we are continuing to closely monitor the situation."

Those affected have experienced vomiting and diarrhea, though health officials have not yet determined what caused the illness.

In response, the CDC said the cruise line and crew have taken several steps to limit the spread of illness on board.

CRUISE BUFFET GUESTS FACE SURPRISE CHARGES FOR TAKING FOOD BACK TO CABINS

Those steps include more frequent cleaning and disinfecting, keeping sick passengers and crew members away from others, and working with health officials on cleaning procedures and reporting cases.

Crew members also collected stool samples from sick individuals to help identify the cause of the outbreak, the agency said.

Test results are still pending, and the CDC said it is monitoring the ship's cleaning efforts and response.

Fox News Digital reached out to the CDC for further details.

Health officials say it can take time to figure out what is making people sick on a cruise ship. While norovirus is a common cause of stomach illnesses on cruise ships, the CDC said it is not always clear what is causing an outbreak when it's first reported.

CLICK HERE FOR MORE LIFESTYLE STORIES

The agency also noted that the 148 cases of illness were reported over the course of the trip so far — so not everyone became sick at the same time. 

To help prevent stomach illnesses, the CDC recommends washing hands often, especially after using the bathroom and before eating.

"This is not the first time we've seen this with cruise ships," said Dr. Tyler Evans, an adult infectious diseases and addiction medicine physician who is also CEO, founder and chief medical officer for Wellness Equity Alliance in California. 

"Cruise ships, I often say, are sort of floating Petri dishes. They're these massive congregate facilities on the sea."

CLICK HERE TO SIGN UP FOR OUR LIFESTYLE NEWSLETTER

He said gastrointestinal illnesses on ships are "very, very common." A main reason is the food, he said — especially buffet set-ups, he noted.

For anyone connected to this particular incident, he said individuals should look for "any sudden onset of vomiting and watery diarrhea. I know it's not glamorous to talk about," he added, "but if you are on the toilet more than five times a day, that is definitely an indication this is not normal and should be checked out by a primary care provider."

Those with at-risk health conditions, particularly older adults, should be seen very promptly by doctors, he also said. 

Pregnant women as well as children need to be treated urgently as well, he said. 

The Caribbean Princess outbreak comes as other cruise ships have also reported similar illnesses this year.

In March, 65 passengers and 11 crew members fell ill aboard Holland America's Westerdam during a February voyage in Asia, Fox News Digital previously reported.

TEST YOURSELF WITH OUR LATEST LIFESTYLE QUIZ

Those affected reported diarrhea, vomiting and fever. Tests conducted by the ship's lab found that stool samples from seven patients were positive for norovirus.

Health officials in Hong Kong boarded the ship on March 1 to investigate the outbreak. 

The cruise line said it increased cleaning and disinfection efforts, while authorities inspected the vessel before allowing new passengers and crew members to board.

Jessica Mekles of Fox News Digital contributed reporting.

title: Introducing Kraken TV: live crypto markets and news on the big screen
description:
Live prices, movers and news on your television, built to be read from across the room or up close.
The post Introducing Kraken TV: live crypto markets and news on the big screen appeared first on Kraken Blog.
fullContent:
TL;DR

  • Kraken TV is a new app for Apple TV, Android TV (including Google TV) and Amazon Fire TV that turns your television into a live crypto market screen. No account, no sign-in and no setup: install it and it works.
  • The new News experience offers a headline-first feed, a saved reading list and a scrolling Market Wire ticker, plus Small, Medium and Big layouts that adapt to how far you’re sitting from the screen, which you can change at any time.
  • An ambient screensaver keeps the latest prices, news and events for your chosen coins on screen for hours, without your TV going to sleep.
  • Kraken TV is a companion to the Kraken app: scan a QR code to continue on your phone and trade the coin there. No trading happens on the TV.

Crypto markets, now on the big screen

Crypto doesn’t stop moving, and your TV doesn’t have to either. Today we’re introducing Kraken TV, a new app for Apple TV, Android TV and Amazon Fire TV that turns your television into a live crypto market screen. Prices, movers and news are all designed to be read from across the room or up close.

There’s nothing to set up. Install Kraken TV and it works, with no account and no sign-in.

Live markets at a glance

Kraken TV opens on Markets, with live prices, 24-hour change and sparklines for the assets you care about, plus the biggest movers so you can see what’s heating up.

A built-in asset picker lets you choose which assets to prioritize, and your selection follows you across the app.

News you can read from the couch

News is the newest part of Kraken TV, and it’s the reason for this launch. We built a browsable, headline-first feed that’s easy to read from the couch:

  • Filter your feed by category or by asset to focus on what matters to you.
  • Open any story to read the full article on screen.
  • Star a story while you’re reading and it lands in your saved reading list.
  • Follow the Market Wire, a scrolling ticker that runs along the bottom of the screen.
  • Scan the QR code on a story that catches your eye to continue on your phone and trade that coin in the Kraken app.

Coin pages built around the news

Select any asset from the grid and you’ll land on its own coin page, built around that coin’s news. It’s a quick way to see what’s driving an asset without leaving the couch.

A screensaver that keeps the market in view

Kraken TV doubles as an ambient screensaver. Build your list of coins, and it keeps their latest prices, news and events on screen for hours without your TV going to sleep.

You stay in the loop without staring at the screen or hunting for information, which makes it a natural fit for a waiting area, a shared space or simply some background atmosphere.

Big, Small, and Medium: one app, three ways to read

The first time you open Kraken TV, we ask how far away you’re sitting. The app then lays itself out for that distance, and you can change your choice at any time:

  • Big uses bigger type and fewer rows, so everything stays legible from across the room.
  • Small shows denser detail for when you’re sitting close.
  • Medium sits in between.

Same app, three genuinely different reading experiences.

Built for a remote control

Kraken TV is designed for a remote, not a cursor. A left-hand rail gives you quick access to every surface, and each one opens as its own window, titled in the header so you always know where you are.

A companion to the Kraken app

Kraken TV is a companion to the Kraken app, not a replacement for it. When something on screen is worth acting on, like a story about a coin you follow, scan the QR code to continue in the Kraken app on your phone and trade from there. No trading happens on the TV.

Available on Apple TV, Android TV and Amazon Fire TV

One build covers Apple TV, Android TV (including Google TV) and Amazon Fire TV. Kraken TV is our first app on the Amazon Appstore. Download Kraken TV on your streaming device, pick how far away you’re sitting, and put the market on the big screen:

  • Apple TV (App Store)
  • Google TV/Android TV (Google Play)
  • Fire TV (Amazon Appstore)

The post Introducing Kraken TV: live crypto markets and news on the big screen appeared first on Kraken Blog.

title: Why Is Akamai Technologies Stock Gaining Thursday?
description:
Akamai Technologies, Inc. (NASDAQ:AKAM) stock is trading higher Thursday after the company announced a collaboration with Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) on Wednesday to extend enterprise browser security capabilities to Microsoft Edge for Business on mobile devices.
Broader market sentiment also improved, with Nasdaq 100 futures up 2.31% and S&P 500 futures gaining 1.33% as investors awaited Anthropic, PBC’s (NASDAQ:ANT) public trading debut.
Cybersecurity stocks are attracting investor interest after Palo Alto Networks, Inc. (NASDAQ:PANW) reported strong first-quarter fiscal 2027 results and issued upbeat guidance.
Several cybersecurity names, including CrowdStrike Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ:CRWD), Okta Inc. (NASDAQ:OKTA), Zscaler Inc. (NASDAQ:ZS), and SentinelOne Inc. (NYSE:S), posted premarket gains on Thursday.
The sector rally comes amid mounting concerns about digital infrastructure security and growing demand for artificial intelligence security solutions.
Akamai Strengthens Mobile Security And AI Governance
The collaboration enables organizations to deploy Akamai Workforce Protector, formerly LayerX, directly within Microsoft Edge for Business on iOS and Android devices.
The solution helps protect enterprises against mobile cyberthreats, malicious URLs, unauthorized generative AI use and sensitive data leaks.
Additionally, employees can continue using Edge for Business instead of switching to a separate corporate browser.
Arunesh Chandra, head of product for Microsoft Edge for Business, highlighted the benefits of centralized security management and a familiar browsing experience for enterprise users.
Akamai Raises $2.46 Billion In Net Proceeds
On Nov. 12, Akamai closed a private offering of $1.25 billion in convertible senior notes due 2028 and another $1.25 billion due 2031.
The company generated $2.46 billion in net proceeds. It used approximately $284.4 million to pay the cost of convertible note hedge transactions, partially offset by proceeds from the sale of warrants.
Akamai plans to use the remaining proceeds to repay at maturity a portion of its $1.15 billion in 0.375% convertible senior notes due 2027, or to cover cash due on any earlier conversion.
It also plans to fund cloud infrastructure capital expenditures and general corporate purposes.
In the release, CFO Ed McGowan said he expects a significant increase in EBITDA margins and cash from operations beginning in 2027.
McGowan anticipates further improvement in 2028 as revenue from the company’s committed cloud infrastructure contracts increases.
Analyst Outlook
Akamai carries a consensus Buy rating with an average price forecast of $133.94.
However, several analysts recently lowered their price forecasts.
Evercore ISI downgraded Akamai to In-Line and lowered its price forecast to $90 on Nov. 11. Baird maintained its Neutral rating and lowered its price forecast to $92 on Nov. 9. Similarly, UBS maintained its Neutral rating and cut its price forecast to $90 on Nov. 6.
AKAM Price Action: Akamai Technologies shares were up 2.51% at $94 during premarket trading Thursday, according to Benzinga Pro data.

title: Ethereum Processes $25.8 Trillion In Stablecoin Transfers — Is Wall Street Underestimating ETH?
description: Ethereum has processed an extraordinary $25.8 trillion in stablecoin transfers during the first ten months of 2026, highlighting the blockchain’s expanding role in global digital finance. The milestone arrives as major financial institutions continue exploring Ethereum-based products, including JPMorgan’s tokenized money market fund. Yet ETH’s market performance has not reflected the same enthusiasm. That disconnect […]
fullContent:
Ethereum has processed an extraordinary $25.8 trillion in stablecoin transfers during the first ten months of 2026, highlighting the blockchain’s expanding role in global digital finance. The milestone arrives as major financial institutions continue exploring Ethereum-based products, including JPMorgan’s tokenized money market fund.

Yet ETH’s market performance has not reflected the same enthusiasm.

That disconnect raises an important question: Is Wall Street overlooking Ethereum’s growing financial infrastructure while focusing too heavily on short-term price movements?

Ethereum’s $25.8 Trillion Milestone Reveals Growing Demand

According to Ethereum Institutional’s State of the Ledger report, published November 5, stablecoin transfers on Ethereum mainnet reached $25.8 trillion between January and October 2026.

That represents a 61% increase from approximately $16 trillion during the corresponding period in 2025.

The number of stablecoin transfers also climbed 2.5 times to approximately 463 million, suggesting that network activity expanded beyond increases in transaction values alone.

However, the figures include all recorded transfers, including internal movements and automated transactions. They should not be interpreted as $25.8 trillion in retail payments or institutional settlements.

Even with that distinction, the growth demonstrates Ethereum’s importance as infrastructure for moving digital dollars.

The findings also reveal a significant improvement in transaction efficiency.

Ethereum mainnet averaged approximately 2.17 million daily transactions during the period, an increase of 54% year over year.

Meanwhile, average daily median transaction fees declined from approximately $0.35 to just $0.035.

The network is handling more activity while becoming considerably cheaper to use.

Why Wall Street Is Paying Attention

Ethereum’s expanding stablecoin activity comes alongside growing interest in tokenized financial products.

BlackRock CEO Larry Fink previously highlighted the potential advantages of blockchain-based financial infrastructure, prompting discussion about Ethereum’s role in tokenization.

The institutional argument is increasingly about practical infrastructure rather than cryptocurrency speculation.

Banks and asset managers are exploring how blockchains can support fund issuance, asset transfers, and digital settlement systems.

Ethereum already provides an established ecosystem of stablecoins, decentralized financial applications, and tokenized assets.

That combination could make it attractive to institutions seeking access to existing liquidity and blockchain-based financial services.

Nevertheless, institutional adoption does not automatically translate into higher ETH prices. Some applications generate substantial activity without producing equivalent demand for the native token.

Ethereum’s Growing Network Security Adds Another Dimension

Stablecoin activity is not the only metric showing expansion.

Ethereum Institutional reported that the amount of ETH staked increased from 33.3 million in October 2025 to 44.2 million by October 31, 2026.

That represents approximately 36.1% of circulating supply, compared with 27.6% one year earlier.

This development adds another dimension to the investment discussion.

Staked ETH helps secure the network while reducing the quantity immediately available for trading, although withdrawals remain possible.

Institutional participation in staking has also attracted attention, with Grayscale expanding its Ethereum staking position earlier this year.

Together, rising staking participation and stablecoin activity suggest that Ethereum’s economic ecosystem continues developing despite market volatility.

Could Ethereum’s Network Growth Support An ETH Recovery?

The central challenge for Ethereum investors is determining how growing network usage translates into value for ETH holders.

Stablecoin transactions require network resources, but Ethereum’s scaling improvements have also reduced fees.

Lower costs make Ethereum more accessible, although they can reduce the amount of ETH burned per transaction.

Consequently, an increase in transfer volume does not necessarily produce a proportional increase in ETH demand.

The strongest bullish scenario would involve continued institutional adoption, expanding stablecoin liquidity, greater use of ETH as collateral, and sustained participation in staking.

However, ETH would still need stronger buying demand to translate these improvements into a lasting market recovery.

Investors should monitor whether network activity continues growing, whether institutional products attract additional capital, and whether transaction economics improve alongside adoption.

Is Ethereum’s Biggest Opportunity Still Ahead?

Ethereum’s $25.8 trillion milestone highlights a fundamental distinction between blockchain adoption and cryptocurrency market performance.

The network is processing more stablecoin transfers, supporting more transactions, and securing more ETH through staking than a year earlier.

Yet the market has not necessarily rewarded those developments through stronger ETH prices.

That divergence creates an interesting opportunity for investors willing to evaluate Ethereum beyond short-term market movements.

If institutional adoption continues expanding, Ethereum’s long-term investment case may increasingly depend on its position as financial infrastructure rather than speculation alone.
